text: A box holds 5 spiders and some beetles, with 58 legs in all. Beetles have 6 legs. How many beetles are there?
why: The spiders have 5 × 8 = 40 legs, leaving 18, and 18 ÷ 6 = 3.

text: A patch of lilies doubles in size every day and covers the whole pond on day 30. On which day did it cover half the pond?
why: It doubles overnight, so the day before it was full it covered half.
